epic.title: Epic: the door is the interface — finish the MCP migration (#567)
epic.intent_and_why: One interface for agents: the MCP door. The CLI becomes an operator and debug path only. The outcome that must not be violated is that this epic reduces complexity by removing a redundant path.

definition_of_done: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door end to end.
No agent-facing file teaches the CLI as a path for agents.
A guard refuses reintroduction of the CLI-fallback text.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: The merge gate is the full suite green on Linux in a clean detached worktree of the branch, never a working copy. Engine and hook behaviour is validated in a fresh process with explicit paths.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Behaviour-level red-proofs against the shipped path rather than a fixture, plus a re-verify of main after each merge.
good_enough.appetite: Two waves planned; a third added by the human after wave 2.

hard_constraints: No lane files an issue during the run.
No lane promotes an observation into docs/agents/*.
Design work is never dispatched as a fork.
Every dispatch and every crew passes --model explicitly.
fixed_decisions: Wave-1 and wave-2 lane identities remain stable and their branches are merged and kept (#412).
The workbench directory stays a template-only package; the four templates do not move.
#574's PR-opening question stays reserved for the human.

current_wave.objective: Close the gap that keeps a second path to the engine alive, and stop launchers taking machine-local defaults, so the epic's own claim is true rather than nearly true.
exit_criteria: A role's authored gates are driven through the door in its own spine, with no second plan file and no invented session id -- or an evidenced finding that this costs more mechanism than it removes.
A real install with --dest outside the repo leaves the repo's tracked .mcp.json byte-identical.
A crew dispatched with no --model runs at its role's default rather than the host's, proven from the registry.
Each lane returns to results/lane-<x>-RETURN.md; no lane files an issue; no lane regenerates map/INDEX.md.
main is re-verified green on Linux in a clean detached worktree after the last merge.

issues.title: A launcher must take declared defaults, not machine-local ones (#619 + #633)
issues.desired_outcome: install_constellation.py stops writing a probed interpreter into a tracked .mcp.json and stops touching the calling repo's file at all when --dest points elsewhere; and run_crew.py resolves a crew's model from a per-role, per-harness table with an allowed set and a recorded reason, never from the host's settings.json.
issues.useful_now: Both already cost real work this epic: an install silently dirtied a tracked file in a repo it was not targeting, and 15 crew sessions ran a tier above the one their lane was assigned, 6 of them abandoned and retried.
issues.appetite: One Commander at Sonnet tier. Two files, one idea.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A real (non-dry-run) install with --dest outside the repo leaves the repo's .mcp.json byte-identical, proven by git diff. And a crew dispatched with no --model runs at its role's default rather than the host default, proven from the registry entry rather than from the code.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the table's shape and where it lives; choose how the harness dimension is expressed.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Ship the table at today's honest tiers, not the target ones: admiral opus, commander sonnet, implementer sonnet, reviewer sonnet, with haiku in the allowed sets. The human's direction is commanders at Sonnet and crews at Haiku or local, and he said explicitly we are not there yet.
The table must express Codex and local models, not only Claude Code. Which entry applies is a function of the harness the agent is running in.
An unset model resolves from the role and fails closed toward the cheaper tier.
A model outside a role's allowed set is refused by name, the way the duplicate-crew guard refuses.
A non-default choice requires a reason, recorded in the registry beside the model.
Do not regenerate or hand-edit map/INDEX.md (#544).
Do not file an issue; stage candidates under .agent-work/567-j/triage-candidates/.
Pass --model sonnet explicitly on every crew you dispatch.
local_unknowns: Whether the harness an agent is running in can be detected, or must be declared.
Whether install_constellation.py's caller-mutation is one bug with the probed interpreter or two separate ones.

issues.title: One spine per agent: frozen bookends, mutable middle, for every planning role (#634)
issues.desired_outcome: A role's authored gates land in its own spine instead of a second file, the steps at the start and finish stay frozen, the middle can be added to, dropped from or rescoped during the run by the agent that owns the spine, and a reader can reconstruct how the plan changed.
issues.useful_now: This is the one exception epic #567 could not sweep. A Commander's execute.json, an Interrogator's interrogation.json and an in-session crew's own plan all reach the engine outside the door, under hand-invented session ids.
issues.appetite: One Commander at Opus tier, design-it-twice before converging. Convergence is human-only: return a comparison and a recommendation.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A Commander drives its authored gates through the door in its own spine, with no second plan file and no invented session id, proven in a fresh process. An evidenced finding that this cannot be had without adding more mechanism than it removes is a complete deliverable.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the mechanism. spine_amend already re-plans a gated checklist under a named authority; whether that is the seam or whether the middle needs a different expression is yours to determine.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Build it for every planning role -- Admiral, Commander and crew -- not for Commanders with a note to generalise later. The human said so directly.

SELF-HOSTING: this changes the rule the Admiral's own live spine runs under. Before merging, a read-only status on the live spine must exit 0, and a mutating verb must be proven against a COPY of a spine, never the live file.
Establish what spine_advance --from_child was for before removing or reshaping it. If that seam exists so a different agent's plan can feed a parent gate, it survives this change and constrains it.
Frozen means frozen: the bookend steps stay fixed. Only the middle is mutable.
Do not regenerate or hand-edit map/INDEX.md (#544).
Do not file an issue; stage candidates under .agent-work/567-k/triage-candidates/.
Design work goes to fresh agents, never a fork. Pass --model sonnet on every crew you dispatch.
local_unknowns: Whether gated spines carry invariants -- why_trail, trip ledger, postcondition evaluation across a grown step -- that appending would break.
Whether the plan-change record is a use of the existing why_trail and spine_amend authority, or needs its own shape.
